errors.text_span: The chart displays a total of eleven slices
errors.evidence: The chart is a donut chart with 10 slices representing different categories. The description incorrectly states there are eleven.

errors.text_span: colored orange, represents 18.7% and is labeled “Press Release”
errors.evidence: The slice for “Press Release” (18.7%) is yellow/gold. The orange slice corresponds to “Social Media Post” (1.1%).
While the color is a shade of green, the chart shows it as a very light green. Calling it just "green" is slightly inaccurate when a dark green slice also exists for "External News Article".
The slice for “External News Article” is dark green, not blue.
The slice for “Intra-agency news article” is a medium blue. The dark blue slice represents “Interview” (8.8%).
The slice for “Interview” is dark blue. The dark green slice represents “External News Article” (18.1%).
The slice for “Event Posting” is a dark red/brown color, not pink.

“Stimulus Type” is the title in the center of the donut chart, not a data slice. The description hallucinates this as a category with a value of 1.1% and a white color. The 1.1% value belongs to the “Social Media Post” category.

errors.text_span: the segments appear to be ordered roughly from largest to smallest in proportion
errors.evidence: The segments are not ordered by size. For example, the largest slice (Draft/Other at 26.4%) is adjacent to the smallest (Social Media Post at 1.1%).
The description completely omits the "Social Media Post (1.1%)" category from its list of slices.
